cards.card_text: If some branches have been broken off, he says, and you, a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others to share in the nourishment of the olive root, then listen up.
cards.verse_text: Now if some branches have been broken off, and you, a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others to share in the nourishment of the olive root,
cards.snippet: …have been broken off, and you, a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others to share in the nourishment of the olive…

cards.card_text: Paul sees the comeback coming from the wild shoot: “Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in.” Paul agrees that's correct, and friend, when somebody agrees with you and KEEPS talking, brace yourself.
cards.verse_text: You will say then, “Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in.” That is correct: They were broken off because of unbelief, but you stand by faith.
cards.snippet: …will say then, “Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in.” That is correct: They were broken off because of unbelief, but…

cards.card_text: Paul says that if the broken-off branches do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in.
cards.verse_text: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
cards.snippet: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

cards.card_text: Paul gives the reason: God is able to graft them in again.
cards.verse_text: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
cards.snippet: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

cards.card_text: If a wild shoot was grafted into a cultivated olive tree, contrary to nature, what does Paul say about the natural branches?
cards.verse_text: For if you were cut from a wild olive tree, and contrary to nature were grafted into one that is cultivated, how much more readily will these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree!
